children: Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin is easily the Empire's second greatest architect and visionary, after the Emperor himself. For many years, he has supplied scholarly arguments for many of the Chancellor's, and subsequently the Emperor's, moves to consolidate power and wield it effectively across the galaxy. This reason, among many, allowed Tarkin to advance quickly in the eyes of the Emperor to become the first Moff after the establishment of the Empire.

. From the beginning, he also spearheaded the Death Star project, working with the newly revealed
to secure hundreds of thousands of

slaves. He reports directly to the Emperor and is one of the most well-informed officials in the Empire. However, it is unclear if Tarkin suspects the extent of the Emperor's Dark Side knowledge, or if he considers such power to be the province of

Recently, the Emperor promoted Tarkin to the rank of Grand Moff, the first use of the title. This event marked the Emperor's full acceptance of the Tarkin Doctrine. As such, Tarkin has taken command of Oversector Outer, to tighten control of
, as well as continuing his other command duties.

Tarkin is distinctive in appearance and commands a room in a way that no other Imperial military officer is capable of. It is significant that even Lord Vader must follow Tarkin's lead in most instances, a privilege not afforded to many Imperial commanders. Since Tarkin is entrusted with the construction of
, he naturally pursues any security threat to the project. He works to keep all knowledge of
hidden from the Imperial Senate and the general public. He is adept at covering his tracks and willing to go to any lengths to protect the project and the Empire itself.
